title: Cross-app notification control
target_segments: knowledge workers who use many collaboration and productivity apps
small teams without dedicated device management
problem_statement: People cannot see why apps interrupt them or manage notification rules consistently across desktop and mobile tools, which leads to broad muting and missed important events.
proposed_wedge: A desktop-first control center that inventories notification settings, explains likely interruption causes, and guides users through supported changes without requiring invasive message access.
excluded_scope: reading private notification content in the MVP

assumptions.statement: Users will grant enough local settings access for an inventory tool to be useful.
assumptions.validation_method: prototype permission walkthrough with target users

assumptions.statement: Guided control is valuable even when direct settings changes are unavailable.
assumptions.validation_method: compare complaints about discovery against complaints about missing automation

dependencies: stable operating-system notification APIs and settings deep links

risks.risk: Operating systems may limit cross-app control.
risks.mitigation: Design the first release around inventory, explanation, and supported deep links.
